localHelpAndBinaryFindings.helpConclusion: Smart200 channels are documented as being added through the device component internal property row: [internal property] = set device internal property.

observed: Smart200.dll is PE32/x86 and exports SvrEditCustomProperty and SvrEditProperties.
Smart200.dll is not loaded by merely entering the device configuration page.
McgsSetE.exe contains UTF-16 strings for [internal property] and set device internal property at offsets 0x69245A and 0x692468.
McgsSetE.exe contains CDevDllPage1..4 and CDlgChlConfig RTTI strings around offsets 0x4A9D2C and 0x4AE660.
Smart200.dll contains ANSI strings for device channel, channel property setting, channel name, and SvrEditCustomProperty/SvrEditProperties.
wndproc can map standard controls such as SysTreeView32 back to COMCTL32.dll; it will be used when a Smart200 dialog is captured.

implementedWorkflow.name: device.channel.map
entryRoute: click the device-configuration entry when the Smart200 tree is not yet visible
select and physically double-click the Smart200 SysTreeView32 node
bind the two top-row ComboBox controls by top-row grouping and left-to-right order
set channel type by area index: I=0, Q=1, M=2, V=3
click access mode, confirm, then verify new rows in the SysListView32 channel table
optionally click 快速连接变量 and use custom variable base; Smart200 appends 00, 01, 02...
on 添加数据对象, click 全部添加
save, close, reopen the copied project, and verify the Smart200 channel table again
notes: The channel address strings are not reliable in blob_strings.json; they appear to be stored in the device binary object. Reopen-and-readback is the acceptance check.
For non-bit channel types, the workflow captures newly added rows from the Smart200 table and uses the real displayed channel text for verification instead of guessing the VB/VW/VD notation.
The MCGS startup prompt 存在同名的不同工程备份 is safe to confirm on copied projects.
The ODBC 选择数据源 startup dialog is canceled by the workflow when it appears.

proven: After reinstall, the Smart200 device editor opens from a physical double-click on the tree node.
The CLI can add Smart200 V-bit channels through the GUI on a copied project.
The CLI can quick-connect variables, accept the data-object creation prompt, save, reopen, and verify the channel table.

nextExperiments: Generalize device.channel.map for Q20.0 through Q20.3 once the HMI variable naming convention is finalized.
Add a workflow option for exact per-channel variable names instead of Smart200 quick-connect base plus numeric suffix.
Do not write WndDevice.lbObjects directly unless the binary object format is fully understood and reversible.
